title: GLauncher v0.5.0 — Bold Obsidian/Orbit Revamp, Built-In Decorations, Hi-Fi Audio, Free Store & Live Dev Chat

83 Animated Discord Avatar Decorations downloaded & bundled directly inside GLauncher for instant offline use + all 697 searchable in Asset Vault

Working Music, Videos & Photos in BOTH Obsidian & Orbit sharing the exact same ps3_audio / ps3_video / ps3_pic folders — now with Real Embedded Song Cover Art & Studio Hi-Fi Audio Quality Enhancer (Hi-Fi+, Bass+, Vocal, Flat EQ)

New Floating Issue & Feedback Chat Box: users type bugs/ideas straight to Viera's live in-launcher Dev Inbox (plus optional Discord Webhook & GitHub Issues!) with live 2-way Dev replies
Code-Locked Dev Role (⚡ VIERA • DEV) + Soft, Silky Obsidian UI Sound Effects with dedicated Volume Slider
